title: Putnami Code-Host Vocabulary
description: The code-host slugs, the words each host uses for its change request and its diff, the public defaults of the hosted slugs, and the marker of the Putnami note on a change request.

noteMarker.description: The first line of the Putnami note: a body is the Putnami note when, after leading spaces, tabs, carriage returns and line feeds, it starts with this marker.

hosts.description: One entry per slug, in the slug order.

changeRequest.description: The noun of a change request, in lower case.

referencePrefix.description: What comes before a change request's number.

diffTab.description: The label of the tab that shows a change request's diff.

defaultHost.description: The public host name; absent when the slug has none.

defaultApiBase.description: The public REST API base URL; absent when the slug has none.
